title: Knowledge
subtitle: Searchable answers from your own documents

empty.title: No knowledge bases yet
empty.description: Knowledge bases you create will appear here. Add files or Google Docs so agents can answer from them.

detail.sourcesDescription: Upload files or connect Google Docs. We split them into chunks so agents can search them.
detail.agentsNote: Agents only answer from knowledge bases attached to them. Attach this one in the agent step after adding sources.

add.title: Add source to “{{name}}”
add.description: Content is chunked, embedded and indexed after you add it
add.hint: PDF, DOCX, TXT, Markdown · up to {{max}} MB each
add.info: Uploaded files don’t sync. To update one, upload the new version — it replaces the old chunks.

googleConnection.title: Connect Google Docs
googleConnection.description: Connect a Google account, then pick the documents this workspace may read. Only the documents you pick become available.
googleConnection.empty: No Google account is connected yet.
googleConnection.loadError: Could not load the Google connection.
googleConnection.errorDetail: Sources from this account stop syncing until you reconnect.

callback.title: Connecting Google Docs
callback.description: Finishing the Google sign-in. You will return to the knowledge base.
callback.denied: Google sign-in was cancelled. Nothing changed.
callback.invalid: This Google sign-in link is incomplete or expired.
callback.missingReturn: The knowledge base for this sign-in is missing. Start again from the knowledge page.

googleConnection.pickerSkipped: Some selected documents could not be added.
googleConnection.pickerAlreadyAdded: These Google Docs were already in this knowledge base and are linked to the new source.
googleConnection.pickerLoadError: Google Picker could not load. Check your connection and try again.
googleConnection.pickerDifferentAccount: Pick documents from one Google account at a time.

details.title: Source details
details.noDocuments: No documents in this source yet.
details.summaryPending: The summary is generated after indexing.
details.sourceFailed: This source could not be indexed.
details.documentFailed: This document could not be indexed.
details.reconnected: Google account reconnected. Retry to finish indexing.

reconnect.message: Sources from {{email}} stopped syncing. Reconnect the account to resume.

rename.title: Rename “{{name}}”
rename.description: Only the source name changes. Indexed content stays the same.
rename.nameInvalid: Enter a name up to {{count}} characters.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.description: This removes the source and its indexed chunks. This cannot be undone.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.description: This deletes the knowledge base. This cannot be undone.

new.title: New knowledge base
new.description: Give your knowledge base a name. You can add sources next.
new.nameInvalid: Enter a name up to {{count}} characters.
new.nameTaken: A knowledge base with this name already exists.
new.failed: Could not create the knowledge base. Try again.

rename.title: Rename knowledge base
rename.description: Give your knowledge base a new name. Its sources and indexed content stay the same.
rename.nameInvalid: Enter a name up to {{count}} characters.
rename.nameTaken: A knowledge base with this name already exists.
